meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 当项目已有代码结构档案时,它分析 Git 改动或 Pull Request:列出被改动的文件,标出可能受影响的组件和架构层,评估风险,并写出 diff-overlay.json,供可视化界面查看改动影响。
howto.when: 当你想分析 Git 改动或 Pull Request,弄清改了什么、影响和风险时。项目需已存在 .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json;缺少时 Claude 会提示先运行 /understand。

say.text: 分析当前未提交的改动会牵连到哪些组件或架构层。
say.note: 以未提交的 diff 作为分析对象。

say.text: 把这个分支和 main 对比,评估改动的风险和影响面。
say.note: 以 main...HEAD 的差异作为对象。

say.text: 查看 PR #123 的改动会影响哪些模块。
say.note: Claude 会尝试提取该 PR 的 diff。

howto.what_en: Maps git diffs or pull requests to nodes in the project knowledge graph; lists changed files, finds affected components and layers via edges, assesses risk, and writes diff-overlay.json for dashboard visualization.
howto.when_en: When you ask to analyze a Git diff or pull request for what changed, impacted components, and risks. Requires .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json; if missing, Claude says to run /understand first.

say_en.text: What components or layers could be affected by my uncommitted changes?
Compare this branch with main and assess risks and impact.
Check whether PR #123's changes affect other modules.
say_en.note: Tries to fetch the PR's diff.
